facts.fact: Orzo 对 Durian 说他们只是老朋友叙旧。
facts.anchor: “We are old friends, catching up.” I offer the explanation he doesn’t deserve.

facts.fact: Durian 说 Cinnamon 没有朋友、是坏运气符。
facts.anchor: “Cinnamon doesn’t have friends,” he responds snidely. “She’s a bad luck charm.”

facts.fact: 她问他怎么知道这是她的车，他指指后面自己的摩托。
facts.anchor: “And my bike is right behind it.”

facts.fact: 她说：你不是陌生人，你是救过我的人。
facts.anchor: She pauses, jutting her chin up at me. “You’re not a stranger. You’re the one who saved me.”

facts.fact: 他自认这辈子没救过任何人，连自己都没救过。
facts.anchor: I have never saved anyone in my life. Not even myself.

facts.fact: 他承认她若离开他活不下去。
facts.anchor: I will not survive if she leaves. I can’t allow her to.

facts.fact: 他叮嘱她别深夜独自来这种地方。
facts.anchor: “You should not come here alone late at night.” Concern filters through my wariness.

facts.fact: 她带他到的水边凉亭，是她的安全之地。
她说小时候妈妈常一消失就是几天，孤单让她到处探索。
facts.anchor: “When I was little, my mom wasn’t the best. She would disappear for days at a time, and loneliness would cause me to explore.

facts.fact: 他的安全之地是脑子深处——断掉感觉就不疼了。
facts.anchor: “My safe place was the recesses of my mind. If I disconnected, I wouldn’t feel his fists. The cigarettes. His belt.”

facts.fact: 她谢他当年把她从那个家、从他自己的童年之苦里救出来。
facts.anchor: “You saved me that night. From the horrors of your home. From the pain of your own childhood,”

facts.fact: 她说他很重要，她原谅他离开，只希望他早一点找到她。
facts.anchor: “You matter,” she grinds out. “I forgive you for leaving. I just wish you had found me again.”

facts.fact: 他承认当初那扇撞断她鼻梁的门是他推的。
facts.anchor: “I’m the one who shoved the door in your face. Who broke your nose,” I admit.

facts.fact: 她笑着把这解释成注定重逢。
facts.anchor: She smiles at the confession. “Our paths were meant to cross again.”
“Cinnamon, I promise I won’t go anywhere again.”
